text:
Counting the grapes on the plate gives about 14: roughly 11 red or dark and 2 green, plus a few more.

Each grape looks small to medium, around 4 to 5 g. That puts the total mass at about 14 × 5 = 70 g.

Grapes run about 0.69 kcal/g, so 70 g is roughly 48 kcal.
